name: Panther

specifications.mobility: Omnidirectional four-wheel steering and drive chassis

features: Full-size service humanoid designed for unmodified home environments
34 high-DoF joints and mass-produced 8-DoF bionic arms
Adaptive intelligent grippers for household object handling
Omnidirectional wheeled base for maneuvering in narrow, cluttered spaces
80 cm upper-body lift for ground-level reach and full-height task coverage
Up to 2070 TOPS edge compute for perception and real-time control
description: UniX AI’s Panther is a full-size home-service humanoid robot built around 34 high-DoF joints, mass-produced 8-DoF bionic arms, adaptive grippers, and an omnidirectional wheeled chassis. It is positioned for real-world household task execution in complex, cluttered environments.
